thread:
triage-bot: [INCIDENT] High queue growth on inference pool 'gpu-pool-4' — autoscaler failing to provision. Severity: P1. Pager sent to @sre-oncall. metric: inference_queue_len=1200, avg_latency_tokens=650ms, autoscaler.errors=23 in 5m :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: Ack'd. I'm on it. Checking recent autoscaler logs and the placement service.

ara: I'm seeing a flurry of allocation failures showing 'no contiguous MIG slot available' across multiple hosts. Looks like fragmentation + mixed MIG sizes.

mohit: Confirm. Sample log from allocator: ```ERROR allocator: allocation failed: required_gpus=4, available_slots=[2xMIG,1xMIG,3xMIG], reason=fragmented_capacity```

kai: If fragmentation is the root, autoscaler keeps hitting max node count without being able to pack workloads. Queue keeps growing. Customers on dedicated pools might be pinned; that's reducing flexibility.

jen: Which customers are hitting timeouts? @customer-success can you surface any high-visibility tenants?

liz: CS: Customers with Dedicated pools: AcmeAnalytics and FinLedger report increased error rates and 502s for batch endpoints. FinLedger oncall pinged us at +1-415-555-0102. ETA on mitigation?

sre-oncall: Short term plan: 1) throttle non-critical jobs, 2) attempt an emergency repack to defragment, 3) increase nodepool max as a temporary measure. Who can trigger repack?

ara: I can run the repack script but it requires temporarily cordoning a few hosts and live-migrating low-priority tasks. Risk: slight tail-latency blips. Recommend notifying CS first.

customer-success: Please proceed — telling customers we're working the mitigation now. Prioritize FinLedger (SLA) and AcmeAnalytics.

ops-bot: autoscaler-controller: scale attempt failed: "NoEligibleNodes: none match placement constraints"

mohit: That error means placement constraints (MIG size affinity + dedicated tags) prevent packing into spare slots. Can we temporarily relax constraints? E.g., allow 16g jobs to run on 32g MIG with soft affinity?

kai: We have a policy that forbids up-sizing MIG automatically for dedicated pools without explicit approval. Given impact, recommend temporary override for the next 30m with strict audit. I'll raise approval in 2 mins.

jen: Commands I'd run — share for audit and runbook trace:
```bash
# cordon low-priority host
kubectl cordon gpu-host-22
# drain low-priority pods with grace 60s
kubectl drain gpu-host-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --label-selector='priority=low'
# trigger repack job
kubectl apply -f /ops/repack-jobs/emergency-repack.yaml
```

ara: Executing drain on gpu-host-22 now. Starting with low-priority workloads only. Will monitor queue delta.

sre-oncall: Also kicking off a manual nodepool scale +1 in us-west-2 to buy breathing room. cloudctl nodepool scale --name=gpupool-4 --replicas=+1 (will revert after steady state).

ops-bot: nodepool-controller: scale accepted for gpupool-4 -> desired=33 (from 32). Provisioning nodes.

mohit: While new nodes come up, repack job is rebalancing; allocator logs show a few placements succeeded: "placed job j-9876 on host gpu-host-45 by combining two 16g slots".

kai: Good. Any effect on queue? Metrics?

ara: queue len dropped from 1200 -> 380 in ~7m after first repack tranche and node scale. Latency 650ms -> 220ms average now. Still some stranded 4-GPU requests failing.

liz: CS update sent to FinLedger & AcmeAnalytics: "We're actively repacking and scaling; expected recovery in 15-30m. We're prioritizing your jobs. Will follow up in 10m."

sre-oncall: Action items: - Keep repack running until stable - Monitor autoscaler error rate - Re-evaluate MIG sizing policy for dedicated pools - Postmortem + runbook updates

mohit: Found root cause chain: 1) recent tenant onboarding created many 2xMIG pinned workloads, 2) autoscaler max nodes hit due to commit caps, 3) placement logic rejected co-locating mixed-MIG workloads. Result: usable capacity stranded in mismatched fragments.

kai: For immediate mitigation, I'm authorizing a 30m override to allow soft affinity placement for non-enterprise-dedicated pools. Please log change in config-change channel.

ara: Override made: placement_policy.soft_affinity=true (expires=30m). Logged at /ops/audit/4523456789. Starting a final repack pass targeting hosts with >60% stranded GPUs.

jen: Noting the manual evacuations and node scale in the incident timeline for postmortem. Please attach allocator traces and the repack job output.

ops-bot: repack-job: completed tranche 3/3, slots consolidated: freed_gpus=28, placements_successful=54, placements_failed=4

sre-oncall: Queue steady at 45, latency back to baseline 95ms. Autoscaler.errors reduced to 0 in the last 5m. Marking incident as mitigated — continuing observation for 1h.

customer-success: Customers acknowledged update. FinLedger says error rate dropping, will reopen if they see anything else.

liz: Thanks everyone. Please start the incident writeup. Include timeline, root cause (fragmentation + policy limits), and recommended fixes: quota buffer for autoscaler, improved repack heuristics, and a change to MIG sizing defaults for new tenants.

sre-oncall: I'll own the postmortem and schedule follow-up with product + infra. Closing pager after observation window. :white_check_mark:

triage-bot: Incident 4523456789 mitigated by actions: emergency repack, temporary soft-affinity override, nodepool scale-up. Postmortem required.
